# Individual Ranking fonts

User-selected typography, confined to Individual Ranking. All font data acquired from redistributable downloads; no installed system font file copied.

Roboto Serif and Bitter static instances are derived from Google Fonts sources under SIL OFL 1.1. Families renamed LoR Ranking Names and LoR Ranking Numerals; copyright and licence names retained. Bitter Pro is a reserved name.

FreeSerif Bold is unmodified GNU FreeFont version 0412.4271, downloaded from the official Ubuntu distribution archive. Its copyright notice and GPL v3 with special font exception accompany it. Upstream source: https://savannah.gnu.org/projects/freefont/ . Corresponding package source: https://launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/fonts-freefont/20211204+svn4273-4build1 .

See ProjectDocs/AI/IndividualRankingStyleAlignment/SelectedTypographyR4/FontSources.json for exact URLs, source hashes, axes and output hashes.
